title: Cloud Security: meter postings
content:
Cloud Security handling of meter postings is governed by these handling clauses.

## Handling basis

The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity.

Meters originate in the provider resource export.

Primary meter quantities use primary quantity unit; a meter is positive and a meter reversal is the negative of the exact erroneous source quantity, capped by the source quantity not already reversed.

Keep original interval, region, configuration and source reference.

Billing actual excess usage permits measured quantities above included primary quantity; no service entitlement is invented by a meter write.

Round measured quantities to meter quantity decimal precision using rounding convention, apply minimum primary interval quantity and round positive billable primary quantities upward to a whole multiple of the smallest billable primary increment.

Stopped or suspended service accrues no primary running usage, but real retained storage and other supplemental services remain billable through supplemental meter.

A rejected or cancelled source is not a billable meter.

Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.

Net primary consumption combines positive meter quantities with negative source reversals, retaining their original service-period grouping.

### Authoritative eligibility 1

Before the applicable meter, meter reversal, supplemental meter action, authoritative system records must establish: The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. The evidence is bound to the same Security event reference.

## Basis Q&A

**What happens when the same export is received again?**

Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.

## Partial meter reversal

Hypothetical case: an erroneous source quantity was 8 workload-hours and 3 workload-hours have already been reversed. At most 5 further workload-hours can be reversed; the further posting is negative.
